  Scenario: AC5 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key answers the first answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write of this story was answered under an idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second entry is recorded

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call that fails or does not answer records no session and no refusal (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call of this story to a consumed operation
    When the call fails or does not answer
    Then no session is answered and no refusal is reported as recorded
